title: fix(studio): an uncommitted nav rename raises the held-edit guard
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu76CdcjMmgYPLs3UuMF1RMq)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：Studio Interfaces 导航编辑器里正在输入、尚未提交（未失焦/未回车）的重命名，现在作为「待保存编辑」上报给工作室已有的 held-edit 守卫。
- 为什么改：此前刷新或关闭标签页会静默丢掉这次重命名，而其他各支柱的未保存编辑都会弹出浏览器离开确认。
- 风险与回滚：低；只新增一个可选回调并接入现有上报，没有第二个 beforeunload 监听；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 中 `navRenameClause` 一段，`AppNavCanvas.tsx` 中 `pendingRename` 一段，新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.navRenameHeld-27464.test.tsx`，预期 4 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27464

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes
- `AppNavCanvas` gains an optional `onRenamePendingChange(label | null)`: a card reports its entry while the rename input differs from the authored label, and takes the report back on commit, on Escape, when the text is typed back, and on unmount. Only a card that reported clears it, so other cards' mounts never erase it.
- The Interfaces pillar folds that report into the one `useHeldEditReport` call it already makes (the leaf's held clause wins, then the rename clause `engine.studio.held.navRename`, en + zh). The surface's existing `unsavedPillarWork` therefore covers it: the one `beforeunload` guard, the shell link guard and Publish's held refusal. ⛔ No second listener, per triage.
- `AppPreview` passes no report and is unchanged.

## Tests
`StudioDesignSurface.navRenameHeld-27464.test.tsx`, through the real `StudioDesignSurface` route: typing a rename makes `beforeunload` cancel; Escape and typing the authored label back release it; a blur commit hands the rename to the nav autosave (the save carries the new label) and the guard releases once it lands. A fourth case renders a bare `AppNavCanvas` with no report (the `AppPreview` shape) and renames as before.

Ablation: deleting the `onRenamePendingChange={setNavRenamePending}` wiring through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob b47faa46 to 2dc39a60) turned the three guard cases red (3 failed, 1 passed); restore verified blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes
- Commit on blur happens before an in-app link click, which is why in-app departures already asked; only the document-level guard missed the uncommitted text.
